items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: “I just got these charts from Kenny Wheeler, do you want to be come over and read through these charts?”

ctx.x: Right? One of the greatest, to me, the greatest bass player on the planet and one of the greatest composers. So he was my landlord and I would go over and play with him all the time. He’d call me up and say, “I just got these charts from Kenny Wheeler, do you want to be come over and read through these charts?” Or, you know, and the big one was he had heart surgery — he had a valve replaced, and this was back in, man, ’82, so it was a little bit newer of a — it wasn’t quite so — the technology was very different.…
Can you imagine what you would have had to pay a teacher to get that kind of stuff, and you still wouldn’t have got it anyway probably. The situation was just sort of perfect for you.
